errors.text: The proposed oxygen-dependent tribo-oxide mechanism is incompatible with the target molecular-dynamics system, which contains no oxidative atmosphere or oxide-forming process.
The generated hypothesis substitutes a different HEA composition, microstructure, and macroscopic sliding experiment for the FeNiCrCoCu/Cu nanoindentation-friction system.
It predicts improved wear resistance and reduced friction at intermediate temperature, whereas the target shows roughly stable wear resistance through 600 K and increasing friction with temperature.
